apps.versionDescription: A new item editor: the photo leads the sheet with Add and Photo with AI on it, the name and price sit in large type with the labels under them, availability and stock come first, and Save stays at the bottom, showing a price change before you keep it.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ordinero uses the camera to scan the sign-in code on your dashboard, to take photos for your menu and to map your room for the table finder.
